## Summary

**Diagnosis:** checkout-api v2.3.1 was unhealthy in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate. The deployment history showed v2.3.0 as the most recent release that was healthy in production.

**Rollback:** Rolled back all production regions to v2.3.0.
- The first rollback attempt partially failed (halted after us-east due to an orchestrator error); a retry completed us-west and eu-west successfully.
- No change-manager approval was required since v2.3.0 had previously been healthy in production.

**Verification:** All regions are now on v2.3.0 and healthy, with the error rate back down to 0.2%.

**Incident:** Opened SEV2 incident **INC-0001** ("checkout-api health check failures after v2.3.1 deploy - rolled back to v2.3.0"), which has paged the on-call engineer and documents the rollback actions taken (including the partial failure and retry).
